SOURCE & CRAFT

A transparent study.

This website and its 3D visualisation were created by Muhammad Rizky. Original product designs, catalogue photography, textures, fonts, and software belong to their respective owners.

Source: NEW HOI AN CATALOGUE 2026.pdf, Living Ikon, supplied by the project owner. All three pages were reviewed: a styled bedroom, a dimensional product sheet, and construction close-ups. Its six products are Queen Bed LV453.B01, King Bed LV453.B02, Bedside LV453.B41, Tallboy LV453.B51, Dresser LV453.B61, and Mirror LV453.B71.

This is an independent visual reconstruction, not official manufacturer CAD, a manufacturing specification, or an official manufacturer website. Permission to commercially redistribute catalogue photography and original product designs should be confirmed with the rights holder. Stated dimensions come from page 2; the beds' printed length × width × height has been normalised to width × depth × height. The catalogue uses one bed photograph for both sizes; the models use their distinct printed widths.

LCM127 Golden Syrup colour, timber species allocation, weave spacing, hidden construction, drawer runners, and joinery are interpretations from photographs. Natural rattan is represented by individually modelled, interlaced solid reeds with real gaps. Drawer inserts have recessed timber backing. Soft bedding may overhang nominal furniture width slightly.

The open exhibition has no walls or roof. Rugs, lamps, poufs, plants, freestanding mirror supports, craft samples, display signs, and soft furnishings are complementary styling, not additional catalogue products. Six unique products appear in twelve placements, with twenty-eight operable drawers.

Wood texture: Ash Veneer — Jenelle van Heerden / Poly Haven · CC0 ↗ Photographed ash provides a generic grained substrate, stained to interpret Golden Syrup; this does not certify the manufacturer's exact species or finish. Fibre normal textures, reed geometry, scene styling, and modelling scripts were authored for this reconstruction.

Browser engine: Three.js 0.186.1 · MIT. Draco decoder: Apache 2.0. Fonts: DM Sans and Instrument Serif, SIL Open Font License. Licence files are supplied in assets/vendor/legal and assets/vendor/three.

Catalogue thumbnails are original source photographs. All gallery images are actual Blender EEVEE renders: four 3840 × 2160 images and one 1600 × 2100 material detail. No AI-generated substitute render is used. The packed native Blender master is also Cycles-ready. The browser loads simplified exhibition meshes and full-detail individual GLBs; real-time environment reflections are not optically accurate planar mirror reflections.

The creator avatar was supplied by the project owner. WhatsApp requests open a draft addressed to +62 813-9317-7004; visitors decide whether to send it. This is a contact workflow, not download protection: static assets and repository files are public.
